title: Network Token Credential
description: A card credential whose verification scheme is a per-transaction cryptogram and Electronic Commerce Indicator. Used for network-tokenized PANs (merchant tokens, wallet-provisioned DPANs, processor-issued network tokens). The `number` field carries the network/wallet token; verification is via `cryptogram` + `eci_value` rather than CVC. The agent selects this credential when the underlying instrument provides cryptographic verification; it selects `card_credential` instead when the verification is a CVC, regardless of whether the PAN itself is an FPAN or a token.

number.description: Network token replacing the underlying FPAN.

cryptogram.description: Per-transaction cryptogram. Structurally required — a network token credential without a cryptogram is a CVC-verified card; submit it as `card_credential` instead.

eci_value.description: Electronic Commerce Indicator. Structurally required alongside `cryptogram`.

constraint.title: Network Token Credential Constraint
constraint.description: Constraint shape for the `network_token` credential type. `cryptogram` and `eci_value` are already schema-required; merchant constraints typically narrow optional fields like expiry only.
